VitaShield

A trust infrastructure platform that combines AI, digital identity, blockchain and compliance to help organisations prove the authenticity of digital assets, identities and records.

Role
Sole product designer & illustrator
Location
UK
Timeline
Jan 2026
Scope
Website design, pitch deck design, illustrations

The problem

Fake certificates, identity fraud, forged documents and AI-generated misinformation leave organisations without a reliable way to prove what is real, and centralised databases can be hacked or quietly modified.

What I did

I designed the website and pitch deck that position VitaShield as the trust layer, the way Stripe is the payments layer. The work turns a technical idea (fingerprinting data, anchoring the proof on-chain and verifying against it) into clear pages and illustrations for universities, governments, healthcare, finance and compliance teams.

The outcome

A story that makes cryptographic verification approachable. Visitors see the problem, the core concept and the platform's capabilities (digital identity, document verification, blockchain security, AI trust and compliance) in a single scroll.
